signal: Spekit joined the Gong Collective to extend Gong's Revenue AI into in-flow coaching, deal-room content and follow-ups for sellers

email.body1:
Evan, saw Spekit join the Gong Collective to extend Revenue AI into in-flow coaching and seller follow-ups.

A partnership that visible usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before they cool, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Spekit off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Evan, quick follow-up for Spekit.

With the Gong partnership lifting demand, the addressable list outpaces rep capacity, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Spekit needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Evan, last bit of proof for Spekit.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Spekit's reply rate likely compares to peer SaaS startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Evan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters right after a major partnership, and I know turning that into pipeline is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales motion? I will tailor it to Spekit either way.
